# Customer discovery: knowledge base

Frameworks for talking to customers without fooling yourself, and for reading what they actually tell you.

Based on methods documented by **Rob Fitzpatrick** in *The Mom Test*. Independent implementation, no affiliation. For the full reasoning behind each framework, read the book ([momtestbook.com](http://momtestbook.com)).

## What is here

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `02-frameworks-extraidos/frameworks-mom-test.md` | The 3 rules, good versus bad questions, signal versus noise, customer slicing, earlyvangelists, zombie leads, conversation planning |
| `03-knowledge-base-rag/kb-principios-regras.md` | Principles on interviewing, commitment and advancement |
| `03-knowledge-base-rag/kb-conceitos-definicoes.md` | Concepts and definitions, for semantic search |
| `03-knowledge-base-rag/kb-exemplos-aplicados.md` | Applied examples of conversations that worked and conversations that did not |
| `04-prompt-templates/` | System prompts for the 5 specialist agents in this base |

## Agents

`interview-coach`, `conversation-analyzer`, `customer-segmenter`, `conversation-planner`, `signal-detector`
